batches.name: Hackensack
batches.why: Four Hackensack parishes, no shared pastor in the 2021-26 appointments. Immaculate Conception links a John Patrick (jppc.net) template; St. Francis of Assisi has a Capuchin pastor from Sept 2026.

batches.name: Ridgewood, Glen Rock, Ho-Ho-Kus, Saddle River
batches.why: Planning Area A. OLMC Ridgewood self-hosts weekly PDFs (/images/bulletins/bulletinMMDDYY.pdf). Separate parishes; no shared pastor found.

batches.name: Mahwah, Ramsey, Upper Saddle River
batches.why: Planning Area A. Two Mahwah parishes (Immaculate Conception, Immaculate Heart of Mary): check whether they share anything. Ukrainian St. Paul (Ramsey) and Ruthenian Holy Spirit (Mahwah) are in the eastern batches, not here.

batches.name: Wyckoff, Franklin Lakes, Midland Park, Oakland, Allendale
batches.why: Planning Area A, five suburban parishes. Guardian Angel (Allendale) is eCatholic 11383 behind Cloudflare (probe get 403; visit.py loads it).

batches.name: Park Ridge, Woodcliff Lake, Hillsdale, Washington Twp
batches.why: Pascack Valley, Planning Area B. Separate parishes.

batches.name: Westwood, Emerson, Haworth, Harrington Park
batches.why: Planning Area B. GCatholic has Harrington Park as its own city name; the directory says 'Harrington Pk'.

batches.name: Old Tappan, Northvale, Norwood, Closter
batches.why: Northern Valley, Planning Area B. Separate parishes.

batches.name: Cresskill, Demarest, Tenafly
batches.why: Planning Area B. GCatholic lists St. Joseph, Demarest twice (18377 at 280 County Rd., 18378 at 274 County Rd.): probably one building listed twice, or a chapel next door. St. Therese, Cresskill is eCatholic 10734 behind Cloudflare.

batches.name: Bergenfield, Dumont, New Milford
batches.why: Planning Area B. Two New Milford parishes (Ascension; St. Joseph, which GCatholic places in Oradell).

batches.name: Paramus and River Edge
batches.why: Planning Area B. Annunciation is eCatholic 20359. GCatholic's Carmelite chapel of St. Therese, Paramus (18535) is here: check for public Mass.

batches.name: Garfield and Wallington
batches.why: Three Garfield parishes, one Polish (St. Stanislaus Kostka), plus Most Sacred Heart, Wallington (Polish site). Our Lady of Sorrows, Garfield (GCatholic 18410) merged into Our Lady of Mount Virgin (sacramental-records list): check whether its church still has Mass. GCatholic's Syro-Malabar mission in Garfield is in an eastern batch.

batches.name: Lodi and Elmwood Park
batches.why: Planning Area C. Two Lodi parishes and St. Leo, Elmwood Park.

batches.name: Fair Lawn, Rochelle Park, Saddle Brook
batches.why: Planning Area C. Church of the Korean Martyrs (Saddle Brook) is a Korean community parish: its bulletin may be in Korean.

batches.name: Lyndhurst and North Arlington
batches.why: Three Lyndhurst parishes and Queen of Peace, North Arlington.

batches.name: Rutherford, East Rutherford, Wood-Ridge, Hasbrouck Heights
batches.why: Planning Area C. Separate parishes.

batches.name: Fort Lee, Edgewater, Cliffside Park
batches.why: Planning Area D. Madonna (Fort Lee) has a Korean pastor and may print in Korean. Holy Trinity, Fort Lee has no website in the directory. The draft models paired Holy Rosary, Edgewater with Hudson parishes.

batches.name: Fairview and Palisades Park
batches.why: Two Fairview and two Palisades Park parishes. St. John the Baptist, Fairview had a temporary administrator from St. Cecilia, Englewood (Jan 2023): check for a shared bulletin then and now.

batches.name: Teaneck, Bogota, Englewood, Leonia
batches.why: St. Anastasia (Teaneck) and St. Joseph (Bogota) are a 'Parish Mission Partners' pair (June 2026 letter) and share a parochial vicar (June 2026 appointments): check whether they now share a bulletin. Bogota uses John Patrick (jppc.net).

batches.name: Ridgefield, Ridgefield Park, Little Ferry, Maywood
batches.why: Planning Area D. Separate parishes.

batches.name: Hoboken
batches.why: Four Hoboken parishes. Our Lady of Grace and St. Joseph is one parish with two GCatholic churches (18427, 18430): check whether St. Joseph still has Mass.

batches.name: North Bergen, Secaucus, Weehawken
batches.why: Planning Area E. GCatholic's Immaculate Heart of Mary chapel, North Bergen (18587) is here: check for public Mass.

batches.name: Union City (Holy Family, St. Augustine, St. Anthony, Sts. Joseph and Michael)
batches.why: The 2025 draft models paired Holy Family with St. Augustine and St. Anthony with Sts. Joseph and Michael; the 2024 attendance for St. Anthony is blank there. Sts. Joseph and Michael merged two Passionist parishes; GCatholic's former St. Michael monastery (38915) is here.

batches.name: West New York, Union City (St. Rocco/St. Brigid)
batches.why: Few parishes, many churches: Holy Redeemer has three GCatholic churches (incl. St. John Nepomucene, Guttenberg, merged per the records list, and Our Lady of Libera); St. Rocco/St. Brigid has St. Brigid in North Bergen. Holy Redeemer's Wix site links a jppc.net template and Wix PDFs; St. Rocco uses jppc.net.

batches.name: Jersey City Heights: Mount Carmel, St. Ann, St. John the Baptist, St. Joseph
batches.why: Our Lady of Mount Carmel's pastor is administrator of St. Ann (Polish) since Nov 2025: check for one bulletin. St. Ann had no 2024 Mass attendance in the draft models.

batches.name: Jersey City: St. Aedan, St. Anne, St. Nicholas, St. Paul of the Cross
batches.why: Planning Area E. St. Aedan stands next to Saint Peter's University (Benedictine pastor from Sept 2026). Separate parishes so far.

batches.name: Bayonne
batches.why: All four Bayonne parishes, a 'Parish Mission Partners' group (June 2026). Merged parishes: St. John Paul II (from OLMC, Assumption, St. Michael, St. Joseph) and Blessed Miriam Teresa (St. Andrew, closed for worship 2024-09-22, decree 2025-05-28; St. Mary Star of the Sea). Check which merged churches still have Mass. JPII links church-bulletin.org; BMT has ParishesOnline/LPi.

batches.name: Downtown Jersey City
batches.why: City centre with closures: St. Mary (Parish of the Resurrection in GCatholic, with St. Bridget, which the records list calls closed; St. Mary 'reopened'), St. Michael (also 'reopened'), St. Patrick & Assumption/All Saints (directory card has no URL). Check which buildings still have Mass.

batches.name: Jersey City: Christ the King, Our Lady of Sorrows, Our Lady of Victories, St. Paul the Apostle
batches.why: Christ the King and Our Lady of Sorrows share a pastor (appointments 2023-06, 2024-04): check for one bulletin. Our Lady of Sorrows has a Traditional Latin Mass community (chaplain appointed April 2026).

batches.name: Jersey City: Holy Rosary, Czestochowa, Mercy, St. Aloysius
batches.why: Planning Area F. Holy Rosary (Italian) and Our Lady of Czestochowa (Polish) are ethnic parishes. Separate pastors.

batches.name: Montclair
batches.why: St. Teresa of Calcutta merged Immaculate Conception and Our Lady of Mount Carmel (records list), and Our Lady of Mount Carmel is listed as an oratory of it: likely one bulletin over 118 and 120. GCatholic's Divine Mercy Hill (Verona, 47767) is here. Newman Center Chapel (Montclair State) is a campus chapel: check for public Mass.

batches.name: Bloomfield and St. Peter, Belleville
batches.why: Planning Area G. Separate parishes.

batches.name: Nutley and St. Anthony, Belleville
batches.why: Planning Area G. Three Nutley parishes.

batches.name: West Orange and St. Raphael, Livingston
batches.why: St. Joseph (West Orange) and St. Raphael (Livingston) had one pastor from 2022: check whether that still holds and whether they share a bulletin. St. Anthony of Padua Oratory is the Institute of Christ the King's (not in the planning-area list); St. Cloud monastery (GCatholic 39184) is here.

batches.name: Livingston, Roseland, Verona, Fairfield
batches.why: Planning Area G. Separate parishes.

batches.name: Caldwell, North Caldwell, Cedar Grove
batches.why: Planning Area G. Separate parishes.

batches.name: East Orange and St. John, Orange
batches.why: Holy Spirit-Our Lady Help of Christians merged two parishes (records list); two closed East Orange parishes (Our Lady of All Souls, Most Blessed Sacrament) are not on any roster.

batches.name: Orange, South Orange, St. Andrew Kim (Maplewood)
batches.why: Seton Hall's Immaculate Conception Chapel (GCatholic 40399) is with Our Lady of Sorrows: a campus chapel, check for public Mass. St. Andrew Kim is a Korean parish.

batches.name: Irvington and St. Joseph, Maplewood
batches.why: Good Shepherd absorbed St. Paul the Apostle and Immaculate Heart of Mary, Maplewood (records list).

batches.name: Harrison and East Newark
batches.why: Holy Cross includes St. Anthony, East Newark, which closes for worship on 2026-11-23 (decree posted 2026-10-10); one pastor for both. Our Lady of Czestochowa (Polish) is separate.

batches.name: Kearny
batches.why: Our Lady of Sorrows and St. Cecilia share a pastor (appointments 2023-06, 2024-05): check for one bulletin. St. Cecilia uses jppc.net. GCatholic's Redemptoris Mater seminary (125251) is with St. Stephen.

batches.name: Newark Ironbound: Mount Carmel, Holy Trinity-Epiphany, Fatima
batches.why: Our Lady of Mount Carmel and Holy Trinity-Epiphany share a pastor (2022, 2025): check for one bulletin. Portuguese and Spanish. GCatholic's Stella Maris chapel (Port Newark, 37946) is here.

batches.name: Newark: St. Benedict, St. Aloysius, St. Casimir
batches.why: St. Benedict and St. Aloysius have had one pastor since at least 2021: check for one bulletin.

batches.name: Newark: St. James, Immaculate Heart of Mary, St. Columba
batches.why: The directory lists St. James twice (130 and 142, same address; only 142 has a website). The planning areas and GCatholic list Immaculate Heart of Mary, Newark (GCatholic 18492, 114 Prospect St.), which the directory does not.

batches.name: Downtown Newark
batches.why: St. Patrick Pro-Cathedral and St. John had one pastor (2021-27): check for one bulletin. St. Stanislaus is with GCatholic's Queen of Angels (closed per the records list). St. Augustine's directory address is a PO box.

batches.name: Newark: Cathedral Basilica, St. Lucy, St. Mary, St. Michael
batches.why: The Cathedral Basilica self-hosts its bulletin on Squarespace ('Monumental Faith'). St. Mary is the Benedictine abbey church; GCatholic's former St. Joseph church (38882) is with it. GCatholic has no entry for the cathedral.

batches.name: North Newark
batches.why: Immaculate Conception and Our Lady of Good Counsel share an address and a pastor (2025): likely one bulletin. St. Francis Xavier's directory domain stfxp.com redirects to nabatara.org (HTTP 522): possibly lost. St. Anthony of Padua (750 N 7th St) is in no other list.

batches.name: Newark: Transfiguration, St. Antoninus, St. Rose of Lima
batches.why: Transfiguration and St. Antoninus are a 'Parish Mission Partners' pair (June 2026). Transfiguration absorbed St. Ann and St. Rocco (records list); GCatholic still lists St. Rocco. GCatholic's Most Blessed Sacrament friary (153721) is with St. Antoninus.

batches.name: Newark: Blessed Sacrament-St. Charles, St. Thomas Aquinas
batches.why: Blessed Sacrament-St. Charles has two GCatholic churches. The records list says a St. Thomas Aquinas, Newark closed (records at Blessed Sacrament, Elizabeth), yet the directory lists St. Thomas Aquinas at 40 Ludlow St: settle which.

batches.name: Westfield and Scotch Plains
batches.why: A 'Parish Mission Partners' group (June 2026): check whether any bulletin is now shared. Immaculate Heart of Mary uses jppc.net.

batches.name: Cranford, Garwood, Mountainside, Springfield
batches.why: Planning Area J. Separate parishes.

batches.name: Summit, New Providence, Berkeley Heights, Short Hills
batches.why: St. Teresa of Avila has a temporary administrator to Feb 2027. GCatholic's Rosary Shrine (Dominican nuns' monastery, 33105) is here: check for public Mass.

batches.name: Plainfield
batches.why: St. Bernard and St. Stanislaus is one merged parish; GCatholic has one church for it, so check whether St. Stanislaus still has Mass. St. Mary self-hosts PDFs; the newest seen was 13 September 2026.

batches.name: Elizabeth: Holy Rosary-St. Michael, Immaculate Conception, IHM-St. Patrick, Fatima
batches.why: Merged parishes with several GCatholic churches (IHM-St. Patrick has two). Our Lady of Fatima absorbed Sacred Heart (records list).

batches.name: Elizabeth: St. Adalbert-Sts. Peter and Paul, St. Hedwig, St. Mary, St. Anthony
batches.why: St. Adalbert (Polish) and Sts. Peter and Paul (Lithuanian) merged; GCatholic lists both churches. St. Mary of the Assumption links ParishesOnline.

batches.name: Elizabeth (Blessed Sacrament, St. Genevieve), Roselle, Roselle Park
batches.why: Planning Area K. Separate parishes.

batches.name: Linden
batches.why: Four Linden parishes. St. Theresa of the Child Jesus houses the Shrine of St. John Paul II (GCatholic group).

batches.name: Hillside and Union
batches.why: St. Catherine of Siena and Christ the King, Hillside have one pastor from July 2026: check whether they now share a bulletin.

batches.name: Rahway, Clark, Kenilworth
batches.why: Divine Mercy merged St. Mary and St. Mark (records list); GCatholic lists both churches. The workbook title says 'Divine Mercy-Includes 603'.

batches.name: Eastern Catholic: Ruthenian (Byzantine Eparchy of Passaic)
batches.why: GCatholic lists these Ruthenian churches in the archdiocese's territory; they belong to the Eparchy of Passaic. Record each as other-jurisdiction after confirming the church exists.

batches.name: Eastern Catholic: Ukrainian, Melkite, Syro-Malabar, Syro-Malankara, Syriac
batches.why: Ukrainian (Archeparchy of Philadelphia), Melkite (Newton), Syro-Malabar (Chicago), Syro-Malankara and Syriac churches GCatholic lists here. Our Lady of Deliverance (25653) is in Woodland Park, Passaic County, outside the archdiocese. Record each as other-jurisdiction.
